title: astragalus neoverticillatus
intro: Astragalus neoverticillatus, commonly known as  Chinese milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus neoverticillatus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
